levels.title: Level 0 Training
levels.description: This Level covers foundational topics to build a strong base in programming and problem-solving.

levels.title: Level 1 Training
levels.description: This level is an intermediate level designed for those with basic programming knowledge, aiming to deepen their problem-solving skills.

topics.title: Your First Steps in Problem Solving
topics.description: Build a strong programming foundation by learning how programs make decisions, process data, and repeat actions through loops.

topics.title: Working with Collections of Data
topics.description: Learn how to store, access, and manipulate sequences of values and text efficiently using arrays and strings.

topics.title: Writing Clean and Efficient Code
topics.description: Discover how to organize solutions using functions and structures while understanding the basics of algorithm efficiency.

topics.title: Essential STL Containers
topics.description: Get familiar with the most frequently used STL containers that simplify implementation and improve productivity during contests.

topics.title: Fast Searching and Data Organization
topics.description: Learn advanced STL containers designed for efficient searching, counting, and data management.

topics.title: Static Range Queries
topics.description: Master techniques that allow answering large numbers of range queries without recomputing results repeatedly.

topics.title: Mathematical Foundations for CP
topics.description: Develop the mathematical tools required for competitive programming, including divisibility, modular operations, and number properties.

topics.title: Mastering Linear Optimization Techniques
topics.description: Learn how to reduce brute-force approaches using two pointers and sliding windows to achieve efficient linear-time solutions.

topics.title: Searching Beyond Sorted Arrays
topics.description: Discover how binary search can be applied to optimization problems, answer spaces, and hidden monotonic conditions.

topics.title: Exploring Every Possibility
topics.description: Learn systematic approaches for generating and testing candidate solutions through recursion and backtracking.

topics.title: Number Theory - Part 1
topics.description: Build a deeper understanding of number theory concepts that appear frequently in contest mathematics.

topics.title: Number Theory - Part 2
topics.description: Learn the techniques behind fast exponentiation, modular inverses, and arithmetic operations under large constraints.

topics.title: Counting Principles
topics.description: Master combinatorial reasoning and counting techniques used to solve complex enumeration problems.

topics.title: Thinking in Bits
topics.description: Learn how computers represent data using bits and discover powerful techniques for manipulating binary values. This session covers bitwise operations, bitmasks, and common patterns used to optimize solutions and represent states efficiently in competitive programming.
